content:
GEOfinder tracks someone's location through a link. Once they click it, their location is displayed in your account.

- By Link: Create and share a custom tracking link to get their IP or GPS location when clicked.
- By Image: Upload an image, generate a tracking link, and share it. Get their location when they click.

- Email Data Leak Alerts: Get notified if your email appears in a data breach.

title: How to Install the App on a New Phone
content:
Please follow the steps below carefully to install the app on a new phone.

Step 1: Remove “Play Services” from the old device
(If you still have access to the old device. If not, please skip this step.)

1. Open Settings → Apps / Applications
2. Locate Play Services in the list of applications and uninstall it
3. Make sure the application no longer appears on the device
4. If you do not see Play Services, please double-check to confirm it has already been removed

Step 2: Unlink the Device from Your uMobix Account

1. Log in to your uMobix account
2. Click on your avatar in the top-right corner
3. Select Settings → Unlink to remove the device from your account

Step 3: Reinstall the App on the New Phone

After unlinking the previous device, you can begin the setup process again from the start. Please make sure to carefully follow each installation step to ensure the app is installed successfully.
